title: Corbin Blackwell rescue (Coldain ring7)
summary: Free Corbin and escort him through the orc and giant ambushes.
overview: Free Corbin and escort him through the orc and giant ambushes.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Prepare before the rescue hand-in starts the moving escort.
The first ambush brings Ry'Gorr bashers directly onto the route.
The second brings Commander Bahreck and Kromrif soldiers. Stay close enough to protect Corbin.
Keep him alive until he reaches the final escape point.
